title: Markets price more Bank of England hikes than economists do
subtitle: Bank Rate, per cent
source: Market path: SONIA pricing via Mortgage One, read 12 October 2026. Economists: Capital Economics, Oxford Economics, Bank of America, Fidelity International, early October 2026
alt: The market path reaches about 4.5 per cent by April 2027 where economists expect a pause at 4.25.
